European Research Event 2nd - 3rd February 2026
Dear {{lead.First Name:default= }},
We would like to invite you to our European Research Event at Intercontinental Paris Le Grand, an iconic luxury hotel in the heart of central Paris, where we'll be presenting our findings from the latest European Research.
Join us for optional networking drinks and dinner on Monday 2nd February at 7:00PM, followed by the event on Tuesday 3rd February from 9:30PM - 4:30PM.
Please note this event will be in English.
